name: Button
description: Triggers an action on the current page, in three levels of emphasis and three sizes.
extends: ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>, with the ref forwarded to the <button>
whenToUse: Trigger an action on the current page: save, submit a form, open a dialog.
Use primary for the main action of a group, secondary or ghost for the others.
whenNotToUse: Navigating to another page or URL: use a link (<a>).
Turning a setting on or off: use a switch or a checkbox.
Showing progress while an action runs: Button has no loading state yet.

props.name: size
props.description: Height, padding and text size, from RECIPES.button.sizes.

props.name: type
props.description: Native button type. Defaults to button so it never submits a form by accident.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Native disabled: not focusable, no click, dimmed.

props.name: children
props.description: The label. Optional in the types, but a button needs a text label or an aria-label.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the recipe with cn().

states.name: default
states.description: primary: color.primary fill with color.onPrimary text. secondary: color.surface fill, color.border hairline, color.text label. ghost: transparent with color.primary text.

states.name: hover
states.description: Only while enabled. primary darkens to a hover shade derived from color.primary; secondary's border turns color.primary; ghost gets a 12% color.primary tint. data-force="hover" pins this state for docs and visual tests.

states.name: focus
states.description: Keyboard focus (focus-visible) shows a 2px color.primary ring with a 2px offset. Mouse clicks show no ring.

states.name: disabled
states.description: 50% opacity, not-allowed cursor, hover styles switched off.

tokens.usage: primary background, ghost text, secondary hover border, focus ring, ghost hover tint.
Corner radius, every variant and size.
Horizontal padding at size md (the web recipe's px-4 has the same value).
Horizontal padding at size lg (px-5, same value).
Label text at size md (text-sm, same value).

keyboard: Tab moves focus to it; Enter and Space activate it (native behaviour).
When disabled it is skipped by Tab and does not fire onClick.
accessibility.focus: Keep the focus-visible ring (2px color.primary, 2px offset). Never remove it without a visible replacement.
accessibility.contrast: Label text at least 4.5:1 against the button background (WCAG 2.2 AA, 1.4.3). Focus ring at least 3:1 against the page (1.4.11).
accessibility.labels: Needs a visible text label as children. Icon-only buttons need an aria-label.

composition: Can be the action of a Card: the 'One system, every stack' Card uses a primary md Button.
Children can mix an icon and text; the recipe spaces them with a gap.
